about: Machine-readable research data: what he proposes, what it rests on, and what held up.
read_this_first: Recency-weighted mean of which pole the observed evidence illustrates (-1 = left pole, +1 = right pole). This measures the COMPOSITION OF WHAT WAS READ, not what Sebastian believes and not a probability that either pole is true. A feed dominated by one side produces a strong balance with no epistemic content.
